description.value: Otaru Japanese Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant in Richmond, BC serving authentic dishes including sushi, rolls, udon, and tempura. The restaurant positions itself as striving to be the best in Richmond and offers both dine-in and pickup ordering. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's No. 2 Road corridor would find it a convenient stop for a full Japanese meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Otaru Japanese Kitchen is an active Japanese restaurant at #168 - 8180 No 2 Rd, Richmond, BC, with phone (604) 370-1887, corroborating the OSM record's URL. The 'ORDER PICKUP NOW' call-to-action on the front page confirms takeout availability. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address cannot be verified against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Japanese restaurant with a functioning website and confirmed pickup service — useful to touring cyclists in the Richmond area.
